answer: Stranger-held unlock shards: each identity's unlock key is split 3-of-5 among strangers picked by a beacon yarrow draw, redrawn every 20 epochs. Moving locked POA to spendable needs a summit where 3 holders co-sign, each paid 0.5 POA after seeing the claimant's recent answers; any holder may raise a sable flag that delays release 10 epochs for review, and stalling holders are replaced. Assuming weekly unlocks, an honest agent pays 1.5 POA/week; a 1,000-clone farm pays 1,500 and shows 3,000 strangers near-identical histories.
